headline: Brent Crude Declines Toward $94 Amid Regional Supplies and OPEC+ Focus
summary: Brent crude dropped 2.3% to $94.15 a barrel as markets weighed supply concerns and recovering Gulf exports ahead of the upcoming OPEC+ meetings.
why: Oil prices are a key macroeconomic driver, directly influencing energy costs, transportation expenses, and global inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Direct market pricing for Brent crude fell by 2.3% to $94.15 per barrel.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Surging supply concerns, recovering Gulf exports, and anticipation surrounding production policy decisions at the OPEC+ meeting drove the pullback.
